facts.c: ACLEDA's Thunes brochure gives a lower limit than its web page: up to USD 2,500 per transaction (China USD 1,300), up to 4 times a day
facts.q: You can transfer money up to US$2,500 (China up to
facts.note: Conflicts with G0018 (web page: up to USD 10,000 per transaction). Brochure undated; web page fee table goes up to USD 10,000.

facts.c: To send by Thunes in the ACLEDA mobile app: open the app, select TRANSFERS, log in with fingerprint, face or PIN, select INTERNATIONAL TRANSFER, choose Thunes, fill in the transfer details, NEXT, fill in the overseas recipient's details, agree to the terms, OK, check the details, CONFIRM
facts.q: How to send money abroad via Thunes
facts.note: Steps 1-13 on the same page; step names copied from the page.

facts.c: ACLEDA Thunes: if you send for cash pickup, you must give the receiver the transfer details including the withdrawal code
facts.q: Please provide this transfer information to the recipient including withdrawal code if you send in cash

facts.c: ACLEDA: an account with no deposit, withdrawal or transfer for more than 12 months becomes a dormant account and the bank charges fees on it
facts.q: for more than 12 months, will automatically become Dormant Account in the system (inactive account). The fees will charge directly from those accounts as determined by the Bank.

facts.c: ACLEDA: if an account falls below its minimum balance, fees are taken from it at the end of each month
facts.q: Fees will be debited from customer's account at the end of each month if the account balance falls below minimum balance
facts.note: General terms; the savings account page (G0033) says no minimum balance for that product.

facts.c: Cambodia's current resident salary-tax bands (0% up to KHR 1,500,000 a month) took effect on 1 January 2023 under Prakas No. 002 of 6 January 2023
facts.q: Effective from 1 January 2023 onwards, the below new salary thresholds shall be implemented for salary
facts.note: Same document: '(Prakas No. 002, dated 6 January 2023)'; 'From 0 to 1,500,000 0%'. Supports G0052 (PwC 2026).

facts.c: Phnom Penh, 2026: food for one person cooking mostly local food costs about USD 150 to 250 a month
facts.q: Budget courses : 150 à 250 dollars par mois pour une personne cuisinant principalement local.

facts.c: Phnom Penh rents in early 2026 averaged about USD 11 per square metre a month, from about USD 7 in basic local buildings
facts.q: loyers moyens situés autour de 11 dollars par mètre carré et par mois, avec une fourchette allant d’environ 7 dollars dans des immeubles locaux basiques

facts.c: Phnom Penh: electricity usually costs USD 30 to 60 a month for moderate use
facts.q: L’électricité représente généralement 30 à 60 dollars par mois pour un usage modéré
